items.title: Will the WNBA discipline A’ja Wilson or Aces players after Game 2 incident?
items.body_excerpt: A’ja Wilson walked to the south baseline at Gainbridge Fieldhouse to approach a courtside fan. LAS VEGAS — It’s been more than 24 hours since the Indiana Fever responded from their “soft” performance on Sunday with a 99-89 Game 2 win , extending the first-round series. And in…
